name: Várad (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Várad (a green shield with a star, a cross and ears of grain) within a yellow wreath of grain, above a scroll inscribed VÁRAD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Várad arms with wreath and scroll
